description_en: Queries the details of a specified network access endpoint
description_zh: 查询指定的网络端点信息
kebab_example: aliyun eiam get-network-access-endpoint --instance-id idaas_ue2jvisn35ea5lmthk267xxxxx --network-access-endpoint-id nae-examplexxxx --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetNetworkAccessEndpoint

parameters.help_en: The ID of the network access endpoint
parameters.name: network_access_endpoint_id

The public egress IP address of the backup network access endpoint.

备份网络访问端点公网出口 IP。

CreateTime.description_en: The time when the network access endpoint was created. The value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds
CreateTime.description_zh: 网络端点创建时间，Unix时间戳格式，单位为毫秒
CreateTime.title_zh: 专属网络端点创建时间。

EgressPrivateIpAddresses.description_en: The private egress IP address ranges of the dedicated network access endpoint. This parameter is returned only when NetworkAccessEndpointType is set to private
EgressPrivateIpAddresses.description_zh: 专属网络端点公网出口IP地址段，当且仅当NetworkEndpointType为专属网络端点（private）时有返回值
EgressPrivateIpAddresses.title_zh: 网络访问端私网出口IP地址列表。

EgressPublicIpAddresses.description_en: The public egress IP address ranges of the shared network access endpoint. This parameter is returned only when NetworkAccessEndpointType is set to shared
EgressPublicIpAddresses.description_zh: 共享网络端点公网出口IP地址段，当且仅当NetworkEndpointType为共享网络端点（shared）时有返回值

EgressPublicIpAddresses.title_zh: 网络访问端点公网出口IP地址段。

NetworkAccessEndpointId.description_en: The ID of the network access endpoint

NetworkAccessEndpointName.description_en: The name of the network access endpoint

NetworkAccessEndpointType.description_en:
The type of the network access endpoint. Valid values:

shared: Shared network access endpoint.
private: Dedicated network access endpoint
NetworkAccessEndpointType.description_zh:
网络端点的类型，取值可选范围：

shared：共享网络端点。
private：专属网络端点
NetworkAccessEndpointType.title_zh: 专属网络端点连接的类型。

SecurityGroupId.description_en: The ID of the security group used by the network access endpoint
SecurityGroupId.description_zh: 专属网络端点使用的安全组ID
SecurityGroupId.title_zh: 专属网络端点使用的安全组ID。

Status.description_en:
The status of the network access endpoint. Valid values:

pending: Pending initialization.
creating: Creating.
running: Running.
deleting: Deleting
Status.description_zh:
网络端点的状态，取值可选范围：

pending：待初始化。
creating：创建中。
running：运行中。
deleting：删除中

UpdateTime.description_en: The time when the network access endpoint was last updated. The value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds
UpdateTime.description_zh: 专属网络端点最近更新时间，Unix时间戳格式，单位为毫秒
UpdateTime.title_zh: 专属网络端点最近更新时间。

VpcId.description_en: The ID of the VPC to which the network access endpoint is connected
VpcId.description_zh: 专属网络端点连接的VPC ID
